job.question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
job.expected_facts: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
job.acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Boston Retirement System RFP for actuarial and consulting services, not the external audit RFP Q&A. It provides no total contractual fees for FY2021 audits.
quotes: Request for Proposal Actuarial and Consulting Services for Pension Benefits Boston Retirement System September 12, 2022
The BRS is seeking proposals to obtain the services of an actuary for the calendar years beginning 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027
